text: DSH Session Workbench 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话工作台，通过适配原生 workspace 浏览器并注册注入脚本，在保留原生会话界面的基础上增加搜索、项目筛选和 Working/Settled 分区。用户可以整理并恢复会话、查看未读完成状态，也可切回原布局。整理记录保存在浏览器本地，代码中未发现外部服务或 API 密钥要求。

DSH Session Workbench adds search and project filters to the DSH Web session list. Users can organize completed sessions into Settled and restore them later, while keeping the native workspace and switching back to its original layout. Organization metadata stays in browser local storage.
想在 DSH 里快速搜索并按项目筛选以前的会话。
如何把已完成的对话从工作列表整理起来，需要时还能放回去？
I want a searchable workspace to sort completed DSH conversations and restore them later.
DSH Session Workbench 的功能「搜索和项目筛选」：在会话工作台输入关键词搜索会话或项目，并可筛选指定项目或未分组会话；结果显示在工作台列表中。
DSH Session Workbench 的功能「可撤销的会话整理」：点击会话旁的整理操作将空闲会话移入 Settled，之后可恢复到上方列表；整理只更新工作台元数据，不删除会话。

dsh-session-inbox README · DSH Session Workbench：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [MIT license](LICENSE)

A compact session sidebar for **DeepSeek Harness**, with a capability-checked enhancement of the current native UI. Group conversations
by project when needed, review completed or actionable chats in an **untitled
upper inbox**, keep unattended runs in a bottom **Working** shelf, and manually
move finished work into **Settled**. Restore the original DSH layout with one click.

dsh-session-inbox README · DSH Session Workbench：The current workbench labels are Chinese. Version `0.5.0` retains the rounded
monochrome icons and bottom floating Undo notice: five seconds, paused while
hovered or focused, without shifting the list.

dsh-session-inbox README · Compatibility policy：Version 0.5.0 admits DSH **0.1.7-rc.1 up to, but not including, 1.0.0 prereleases**,
excluding the known-broken **0.2.2-alpha.2**. DSH evaluates prereleases with
`includePrerelease: true`. Build metadata does not change this policy.

dsh-session-inbox README · Compatibility policy：The original workspace plugin stays enabled. The host reads its current native
module through `clientModules.clientPath` and prepares an in-memory enhancement;
the browser applies it only if that exact factory is still being loaded. Native
services, menus, dependencies and CSS remain owned by the current DSH release.
Changed hooks, missing capabilities, rendering errors and plugin disposal retain
or restore the current native session list, with a brief fallback notice when needed.
Installed DSH files and conversation records are never patched.

dsh-session-inbox README · Compatibility policy：The integration still uses a few inspected native view hooks; it is not a promise
of compatibility with every future UI redesign. Normal version changes no longer
require an allowlist update. Incompatible changes may temporarily remove the
workbench enhancement while leaving native DSH usable. The 1.0 boundary requires
a new assessment.

dsh-session-inbox README · Compatibility policy：Sixteen published native workspace/sidebar pairs remain regression fixtures:
0.1.7-rc.1/rc.2; 0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2; 0.2.1-alpha.1–alpha.5 and rc.1–rc.5;
0.2.2-alpha.3/rc.1. They are not shipped as runtime substitutes. Browser regression
uses official 0.1.7-rc.1, 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1 Web hosts in isolated profiles,
including native-factory-change and lifecycle fallback checks. Empty fixture
sessions are presented as nonblank only in the browser; no model API calls.
Synthetic future version labels test admission, not an unreleased DSH runtime.
Other platforms, live model turns and arbitrary third-party combinations need
separate acceptance.

dsh-session-inbox README · Compatibility policy：Release 0.5.0 passed 85 JavaScript tests, 6 installer tests and 15 isolated Windows Web checks on each of the three runtimes above (45 browser checks total). DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 remains excluded after native first-run acknowledgement and session creation failures reproduced without the plugin.
dsh-session-inbox README · Compatibility policy：Completed work stays at the top without a section heading. During execution, Working appears above Settled at the bottom:

dsh-session-inbox README · Install：In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins → Add plugin → Git source** and use:

```text
https://github.com/Tracest/dsh-session-inbox
```

For a command-line web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Tracest/dsh-session-inbox.git
```

dsh-session-inbox README · Install：Use the profile that serves your application. Installing into `web` does not
change DSH Desktop's `desktop` profile. The compiled browser bundle is checked
in, so installation does not run a build script or require an npm account.
After installation, exit and reopen DSH when its tasks are idle so the current native module and its enhancement load together.

dsh-session-inbox README · Install：If you are upgrading the earlier local-only build, remove its marked
`# dsh-session-inbox managed section` override using that build's recovery script
before adding this standard bundle. Never load both copies at once. Chat logs
and local Settle records use the same storage key and remain available.

dsh-session-inbox README · Discover index：On DSH 0.2.2, enable the experimental **Custom plugin indexes** bundle, then
add this URL in **Plugins → Discover → Add index source**:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tracest/dsh-session-inbox/main/market/index.json
```

This is the author-maintained source for this plugin. It is separate from
community catalogs, whose inclusion is subject to their own review.

dsh-session-inbox README · What it changes：- Compact header with New session and the native sidebar toggle.
- One search row with project filter and list options.
- The upper inbox has no section title. Completed, idle and awaiting-input chats
  are shown there directly; they remain until manually settled.
- Only unattended running work goes into the bottom Working shelf. Completion
  or a request for input returns it to the upper inbox, ordered by return time.
  The Working shelf is hidden when empty.
- Project grouping is optional and defaults off. It groups only the upper inbox;
  bottom shelves stay compact and show the project on each row.
- Settle and Restore change only the plugin's list metadata. They do not
  archive, delete, stop, or rewrite a conversation.
- Settled stays at the bottom and scrolls independently when expanded.
- The native global tool entries sit in a compact top grid, retaining their icons,
  accessible names, callbacks and registration order. The account menu stays below.
- The **原布局** button restores the complete original sidebar and session
  browser from the top control row. **切到工作台** returns to the workbench.
  Original mode keeps the native list's

dsh-session-inbox README · What it changes：The folder button filters projects. **⋯** controls project grouping, native archive visibility, project management, and refresh. An archived chat's open button is explicitly labelled “restore and open”: that action uses DSH's native unarchive operation; Settle does not. Search reveals settled matches without changing saved folds:

dsh-session-inbox README · What it changes：Native session operations are available directly in the workbench: Original mode restores the native sidebar and list styling, with a small return control beside the list header:

dsh-session-inbox README · Compatibility with other plugins：| Plugin extension | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Standard `sidebar.panellist` entries | Discovered by the official sidebar and displayed in the top tool grid; additional entries wrap onto another row. |
| Models, tools, MCP, skills, conversation panels | Their registrations and configuration remain in DSH. This package does not replace them. |
| Context, image generation, tide badge, task board | Coexistence and their available UI entries were verified on macOS DSH 0.2.1-rc.5. |
| Native session-row menus, leading decorations and hover extensions | Rendered through the original slot contracts, retaining native operations and permission checks. Individual third-party extensions still need their own verification. |
| Extra hover buttons registered only through `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` | The workbench keeps its menu and Settle actions compact. Row-button-only extensions remain available in the original layout. |
| Another plugin replacing `sidebar`, `sidebar.workspaces`, or the `uiWorkspace` service | Mutually exclusive unless specifically adapted. Keep only one replacement enabled. |
| Themes that override side

dsh-session-inbox README · Data and removal：Preferences, collapsed groups, and Settle marks stay in the current DSH
browser origin's `localStorage`, under `dsh-session-inbox:state:v1`. They are not
part of the chat log and are not shared across devices. Clearing site data
removes those extra marks. Fresh user activity or renewed execution reopens a settled conversation; it
returns to the upper inbox once execution completes. Old history hydration
does not reopen a settled conversation.

dsh-session-inbox README · Data and removal：Use **⋯ → 导出整理备份…** to save a JSON backup and **恢复整理备份…** to preview
and merge it. The file contains session identifiers, Settle timestamps and display
preferences; it excludes conversation bodies, titles, paths and account settings.
Keep it with your own files. Import retains current marks and preferences by
default, with an optional preference restore. Active, waiting and newly updated
conversations cannot be hidden by importing an old backup. This is list metadata
backup, not a conversation export or cross-device chat sync. A saved file is
needed to recover those marks after clearing site data.

dsh-session-inbox README · Data and removal： Switching layouts does not uninstall anything. To remove a standard bundle, use DSH's plugin manager, or for the CLI profile: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-inbox ```

dsh-session-inbox README · Data and removal：Then restart when idle. DSH restores its official workspace module. The optional
`install.py` and `.command` files are only for local macOS installation; their
recovery helper removes only its own profile override, not a manager-installed
bundle. No install-time script runs automatically.

dsh-session-inbox README · Development：No JavaScript dependencies are needed for the build and unit tests.
`compatibility.json` owns the admission policy and regression fixture list.
`build.mjs` validates the hooks against every fixture, normalizes line endings,
checks generated syntax and records upstream hashes. The package ships one small
bootstrap and one enhancement template, not sixteen copied workspace modules.
At runtime the host prepares the template against the current native factory;
compact styles resolve class names from the native sidebar's own loaded sheet.
Both official workspace and sidebar modules remain enabled.

dsh-session-inbox README · Development：The **DSH compatibility** GitHub workflow runs the browser regression on pushes.
Its manual `dsh_version` input can check a newly published upstream release without
changing the allowlist or plugin package. This is a check, not automatic publishing.

dsh-session-inbox README · Development：Checks cover classification, safe Settle/restore, resumed work, corrupt state,
partial catalogs, legacy preferences, stale timestamp hydration, and previously
settled empty chats. Earlier releases on the macOS desktop were exercised with real model
turns, project creation/rename, filters, collapse/expand, native tool navigation,
layout switching, and cold starts. That evidence does not establish universal
third-party or cross-platform support.
Search expansion, literal highlighting, pending priority, completion acknowledgement,
backup validation and merge preservation have additional regression checks.
Every fixture's complete native CSS payloads and the stylesheet lifecycle are checked,
including switching modes and disposing a replaced UI module.
New hosts use the native context-menu service; older hosts use native menu slots
and their open-state context. Both retain button, right-click and Shift+F10 access,
and use the host's rename permission hook when available.

dsh-session-inbox README · Attribution：[DeepSeek's MIT notice](vendor/LICENSE.deepseek) is retained for native regression fixtures and the runtime enhancement. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
The compact header and Working/Settled organization were inspired by T3 Code.
This workbench keeps its tool grid above the list; no T3 Code implementation is included.

Independent community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek or T3 Code.

dsh-session-inbox README · DSH 会话工作台：[English](README.md) · [MIT 许可证](LICENSE) 包名：**`dsh-session-inbox`**。`0.5.0` 改为**检测当前 DSH 接口并增强原生列表**，界面为中文。 支持上方无标题的待查看列表、底部工作中与已整理、可选项目分组、一键 Settle 和原布局切换。 新版将工作台图标统一为接近 Claude 的圆角单色线条，保留勾选整理功能。 “已整理 · 撤销”在侧栏底部浮动显示，不挤动列表；约 5 秒后消失，悬停或键盘聚焦时暂停计时。 完成待查看的会话直接出现在上方，没有分类标题。运行时，底部工作中显示在已整理上方：

dsh-session-inbox README · 安装：在 DSH 桌面版中打开“插件 → 添加插件 → Git 来源”，填写：

```text
https://github.com/Tracest/dsh-session-inbox
```

命令行启动的 Web 版可运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Tracest/dsh-session-inbox.git
```

`web` 和桌面版的 `desktop` 是不同配置。请安装到实际运行的配置中。包内已有编译结果，
安装时不运行构建脚本，也不需要 npm 账号。安装完成后在任务空闲时正常退出并重新打开 DSH，
使界面依赖完整重新绑定。

dsh-session-inbox README · 兼容策略：安装范围为 **DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 起、1.0.0 预发布版之前**，排除已确认有原生故障的
**0.2.2-alpha.2**。DSH 的版本检查包含预发布版；构建元数据不影响范围判断。

原生工作区插件保持启用。插件从宿主公开的 `clientModules.clientPath` 读取当前原生模块，
在内存中生成增强版本；只有浏览器实际加载的模块与检查过的内容完全一致时才启用。
服务、依赖、菜单和完整原生样式继续来自当前 DSH，不再携带十六份旧界面代码供运行时替换。
接口、代码结构或渲染发生不兼容变化时回到当前宿主原生列表，并短暂提示；停用插件也恢复原生列表。
不修改 DSH 安装文件或聊天记录。

正常升级不再需要逐个增加版本白名单。仍有少量需要检查的原生界面接入点，
所以不能保证未来任何改版都无需维护：遇到不兼容改版时，增强界面会暂时停用；
1.0 版本需要重新评估。

dsh-session-inbox README · 兼容策略：仓库保留 16 组已发布原生模块作为回归样本：
0.1.7-rc.1/rc.2、0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2、0.2.1-alpha.1～alpha.5/rc.1～rc.5、
0.2.2-alpha.3/rc.1。浏览器回归使用 0.1.7-rc.1、0.2.1-rc.5、0.2.2-rc.1
官方 Web 运行时和独立配置，包含代码变化回退及停用恢复检查。
空测试会话仅由浏览器夹具呈现为非空，不调用模型 API。
模拟未来版本号只验证准入策略，不代表测试了尚未发布的 DSH；
其他平台、真实模型对话与任意第三方插件组合仍需单独验收。

0.5.0 已通过 85 项 JavaScript 测试、6 项安装器测试，以及上述三个版本各 15 项
Windows 隔离 Web 检查，共 45 项浏览器检查。

0.2.2-alpha.2 在未装插件的实例中也出现首次启动确认和创建会话失败，继续排除。

dsh-session-inbox README · 兼容策略：从早期本地版升级：先用早期版本的恢复脚本移除 `# dsh-session-inbox managed section` 覆盖段，
再安装标准插件包，避免两份同时加载。聊天不删除，整理状态沿用同一个本地存储键。

dsh-session-inbox README · 发现页订阅：在 DSH 0.2.2 中开启实验性“自定义插件索引”，然后进入“插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源”，填写：

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tracest/dsh-session-inbox/main/market/index.json
```

这是作者维护的可直接安装索引，与需要单独审核的社区总目录是两回事。

dsh-session-inbox README · 使用：- 顶部是紧凑标识、新会话和收起按钮，下一行集中放置插件、自动化、上下文、看板和更多入口；搜索、项目筛选、列表设置与原布局切换放在其下。
- 上方直接显示已完成、空闲或等待你回复的会话，没有分类标题；在你手动 Settle 前保留。
- 真正运行中的任务放在底部“工作中”，完成或需要审批、回答、计划审阅时回到上方，并优先显示刚返回的会话。没有运行任务时隐藏工作中。
- 项目分组是可选功能，默认关闭；开启后只给上方列表分组，底部会话行直接显示项目。
- 会话右侧 ✓ 执行 Settle，移入底部已整理；↶ 可恢复。运行中或等待回复时不能误整理。
- Settle 只改列表元数据，不执行归档、删除、停止或聊天日志改写。会话再次运行或有新消息会自动重新出现。
- 已整理固定在底部，展开内容独立滚动。
- 官方全局面板入口集中在顶部，保留图标、文字、注册顺序和点击行为；账号菜单留在底部。
- 点上方控制区的“原布局”恢复完整原生侧栏与列表；点“切到工作台”返回。
- 原布局保留默认列表的样式与间距，仅在列表标题旁增加小型返回入口；展开原生搜索时自动隐藏，避免挤占搜索空间。
- 文件夹按钮筛选项目；“⋯”设置分组、原归档显示、管理项目和刷新。
- 搜索会临时展开匹配的项目与分栏，突出标题和项目中的关键词，并显示结果数量。清空后恢复原来的折叠状态；搜索范围是标题、项目和目录，不是聊天正文。
- 会话右侧“⋯”、右键或 Shift+F10 打开原生会话菜单，包括置顶、重命名、分叉、归档及其他插件注册的菜单项。双击标题可重命名。
- 新结果以未读圆点和加粗标题提示；打开会话或 Settle 后清除。等待审批、回答或计划审阅的会话优先显示在上方，仍不增加分类标题。
- DSH 原来的搜索快捷键仍有效（macOS 默认 Command+K）。搜索框中按 ↑/↓ 选择结果；列表中按 ↑/↓、Home/End 移动，Enter 打开，Shift+Enter 整理或恢复，Esc 清除搜索并回到搜索框。不会接管聊天输入框的按键。
- 带“原生归档”标识的聊天，其打开按钮明确为“恢复并打开”，该操作会使用 DSH 的原生恢复功能；Settle 不改变归档状态。

section: 与其他插件的兼容范围

text: dsh-session-inbox README · 数据与卸载：整理、折叠和显示偏好保存于当前 DSH 来源的 `localStorage`，键为 `dsh-session-inbox:state:v1`。 它们不会改写历史，也不会跨设备同步；清理站点数据会重置这些额外标记。 旧摘要补齐或重连不会取消已有 Settle 标记。此前已整理过的空会话也保留在已整理中。 在“⋯”中选择 **导出整理备份…**，即可保存 JSON 文件；选择 **恢复整理备份…**，预览数量和时间后合并恢复。 备份只含会话标识、整理时间和显示偏好，不含聊天正文、标题、目录或账户配置；请与自己的文件一起妥善保管。 恢复默认保留当前显示偏好，可勾选同时恢复分组和折叠设置。现有整理记录不会被整批替换，运行中、等待输入和有新活动的会话不会被旧备份隐藏。 备份不是聊天导出或跨设备聊天同步；清理站点数据后，需要保留的备份文件才能恢复这些额外标记。

dsh-session-inbox README · 数据与卸载：日常用“原布局”切换即可。卸载标准包请使用 DSH 插件管理，命令行 Web 配置也可运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-inbox
```

任务空闲时重启后恢复官方模块，聊天和整理元数据保留。

`install.py` 和 `.command` 是可选的 macOS 本地安装辅助，不会在标准安装时自动执行。
本地恢复脚本只移除它自己的覆盖段，不能替代标准插件包的卸载。

dsh-session-inbox README · 开发与验证：```sh
npm run build
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

构建和单元测试不需要额外 JavaScript 依赖。`compatibility.json` 维护准入范围和回归样本，
构建脚本逐个验证接入点、归一化换行、检查输出语法并记录上游哈希。
安装包只携带启动入口与增强模板。运行时针对当前宿主模块生成增强版本，
紧凑样式从官方侧栏自己的样式表解析当前类名；官方工作区和侧栏均保持启用。

GitHub 的 **DSH compatibility** 工作流会在推送时运行浏览器回归；
